primary_metric: Mean average precision across clean, 10%, 30%, and 50% MCAR conditions; equal weight by condition
prior_art_status: Close prior art exists for joint supervised imputation, mask-aware prediction, and missingness augmentation. Exact scalar parameterization not exhaustively searched; novelty is unestablished.
limitations: Training augmentation masks were not replayed identically between the learned-scalar and fixed-median arms.
Early stopping used clean validation AP instead of the preregistered average across four missingness conditions.
Held-out scores are exploratory; no post-result rerun was made.
Only synthetic MCAR data and three seeds were studied.
Inference runtime was not recorded separately.
The small observed mean gain (+0.00007 AP) is below the preregistered +0.01 pass threshold and only one seed has a positive paired difference.
